chunks: Ṭalḥah al-Sulamī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
For what reason are the hands placed upon the ground in sajdah before the knees? He said: “Because the two hands are, through them, the key of salat (prayer).”

key_terms.الرُّكْبَتَيْنِ: the two knees, mentioned in contrast to the hands
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the ground upon which prostration is performed
key_terms.الْيَدَانِ: the two hands, which are placed first in sajdah
key_terms.عِلَّةٍ: the underlying reason or cause for a ruling or practice
key_terms.مِفْتَاحُ: the key; that by which something is opened or begun

ai.seo_question: Why are the hands placed on the ground before the knees in sajdah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a reason for placing the hands on the ground before the knees in sajdah during salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains this practice by describing the hands as the key to salat (prayer), indicating their special role in entering and performing the act of worship.
